test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

You can ask Mr. Dinakar for anything; he __would give you the shirt off his back__.

options.text: is willing to do anything to help another person
is a person who makes the decisions
is a person who is selfish
is a person who is arrogant

solution:
The correct answer is- **"is willing to do anything to help another person**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"is willing to do anything to help another person**" is the most appropriate option to substitute.
 
• The idiom "would give someone the shirt off his or her back" is used to mean- " **to do anything to help (someone)**".
 
• Thus, ***option 1)*** is the correct alternative.
